title: Existence checks cannot catch relevance errors
summary: Cheap-model over-claims cite files and symbols that really exist but do not implement the item (for example citing a generic telemetry module as partial evidence for an OpenTelemetry projection). Verifying existence at the pinned base removed almost nothing. Relevance needs either an objective task definition or a judge; a deterministic check is only useful where the claim itself is mechanically checkable.

provenance.author_tier: frontier (Opus 5.5) analysis of deterministic eval output
